content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkTxConfirmation callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> call: • result The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_- <CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkTxCon- firmation callback.
